technical-summary: patch-promote no longer refuses to open a radiance release PR until a lab-staged runtime_assets record exists for the tag. Radiance releases are bundled by CI after release-please publishes them (radiance-release-bundle.yml on release: published), and release-install verifies that bundle against the tag. pin-release's lab bundle path is unchanged.
user-summary-candidate: Patch promotions release without waiting for a lab-built bundle; CI bundles each published radiance release.
